observation_window_utc.method: Raw record mtime minus subprocess elapsed; approximate interval, not event log.

formal.method: Fresh child process per version/case/repetition; serial alternating AB/BA and reversed case order. One cold and one identical warm request. Startup separate. All werewolf modules preloaded before evaluation. System busy minus worker CPU estimates background; >10% flagged and separate low-background subset reported, never silently dropped. Timeouts/Pending are censored. Diagnostics separate.

observation_window_utc.method: Raw record mtime minus subprocess elapsed; approximate interval, not event log.

three_way.method: Fresh serial processes; three-way alternating before/prefix/prefix-disabled; same current harness and fixed archived sources. Prefix-disabled changes only cacheable_evidence; retains existing step/kernel memoization. Five repetitions; two cases; cold and warm. All trials retained.

interpretation.decision: No demonstrated CPU or wall-time benefit from prefix addition. Do not adopt it as a performance fix. Keep the 899b453 ownership fix and existing exact step/kernel reuse as the safe alternative. Current prefix implementation remains in local history for reproducibility; no rollback is claimed.
interpretation.memory_scope: Native whole-worker peak includes startup, semantic output and both cold/warm requests, not isolated per-request allocations.
interpretation.load_scope: Every trial retained; background >10% flagged separately. Short cases can be dominated by startup/background estimation; no causal attribution from one sample.
interpretation.prior_failure: Previous ordinary 681-test run had one real HTTP 20-second budget failure; successful current isolated timings cannot erase that result.
interpretation.semantic_scope: No relaxed budgets or expected values. Complete result digests compared exactly; Pending censored separately.

before.method: Separate instrumented diagnostic with wall deadline disabled, max_work unchanged; inclusive phase times overlap and cannot be added; not a formal baseline.

disabled.method: Separate instrumented diagnostic with wall deadline disabled, max_work unchanged; inclusive phase times overlap and cannot be added; not a formal baseline.

prefix.method: Separate instrumented diagnostic with wall deadline disabled, max_work unchanged; inclusive phase times overlap and cannot be added; not a formal baseline.
